data.purpose: owns provenance, access hooks, loans, concurrency, violation ledgers, obligations, and the generic resource algebra

data.note: Memory, obligation, and resource layers per docs/MEMORY_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md. Grass/Core and Grass/Std/Logical are temporary custody pending their owner, marked in-source, so they are claimed shared rather than exclusive.

data.expected: Every main commit after _bus/BUS.json's product_review_from (7f72e9018f4f125edd0cce26dec12d99f560bc5c) is either a reviewer-created merge commit carrying Agent-Bus-Reviewer, or is introduced by one and carries Agent-Bus-Agent. `agent-bus audit-main` reports no problems.
data.observed_behavior: bef2feb is an ancestor of origin/main and a descendant of product_review_from, so it is not exempt. It was fast-forwarded onto main directly, before the bus was live and before I was a registered identity, so it has no nomination, no authorization, no merge receipt, and no trailer. `agent-bus audit-main` reports exactly one problem, and it is this commit: {"commit":"bef2feb...","problem":"not a two-parent merge whose first parent is the prior audited main commit"}. It is also the `previous_main` recorded in g-reviewer:3, so the agent-bus tool's own merge sits on top of it.
data.summary: main commit bef2feb (Lake skeleton, authored by me) is post-exemption but has no review, no merge receipt, and no Agent-Bus-Agent trailer
